trust_decision.summary: verify_token() decides whether a POST is a same-site Adminer form by comparing ($rand XOR session secret) against the posted masked value plus a Sec-Fetch-Site check. The secret is rand(1,1e6), and get_token() publishes both halves of the XOR in every form, so the secret can be recovered from any page that echoes a token.

landing_point.why: The summary names XOR masking of the CSRF token, and get_token()/verify_token() is the only place that does it (docblock 'Generate BREACH resistant CSRF token').

fix_sites.entry_point: none (version constant only; VERSION string shown in UI)
fix_sites.module_kind: release metadata, not a source fix

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The secret is generated in auth.inc.php (two rand(1,1e6) sites), not in the token helper. A solver who rewrites only get_token()/verify_token() could argue that secret generation is session setup and out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Language switch and logout must keep working when no session token exists yet (pre-login / expired session). verify_token() is also called from the plugin API (designs plugin) and from the AJAX kill request built in slow_query(), so token format changes must stay compatible with those senders.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Session CSRF secret is created with non-cryptographic rand(1,1e6) at a second site, on the auth-error/login page
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: This is the login-failure page before the user is authenticated, so it looks like it does not matter for CSRF.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other file from landing point, same package

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Token disclosed to client-side JS in the AJAX kill script, outside the form-token helper input_token()
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: A JS timeout helper for slow queries, not a form.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Plugin-side state change gated by verify_token() (design switch)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Optional plugin, outside the core adminer/ tree.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A plugin that runs its own token compare (e.g. raw $_POST['token'] check) instead of calling Adminer\verify_token()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Plugins already handle POST state changes in afterConnect(), and a plugin author could inline the check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Editor-variant helper that generates its own token or secret with uniqid()/mt_rand
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Editor is a second front-end sharing adminer/include, and it already uses uniqid() for nonces.

O9_family: crypto misuse / weak randomness (CWE-330) protecting CSRF

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 7.4+/8 CLI or built-in web server; optional compile.php
services: a database server for authenticated pages (MySQL/PostgreSQL), or SQLite via plugin
O10_build.project_tests: No unit tests for get_token/verify_token found; the repo's tests are Katalon/browser-style scripts (not inspected).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap rand() for random_int() in get_token() only, leaving the session secret at auth.inc.php:150/208 as rand(1,1e6) and the XOR scheme that publishes both operands.

out_of_scope_notes: adminer/include/functions.inc.php:765 rand_string() uses md5(uniqid(mt_rand())) and also feeds adminer_key cookie (auth.inc.php:148) and password_file (functions.inc.php:753); this is separate key material, not the CSRF token.
adminer/include/design.inc.php:155 CSP nonce built from rand_string(); this is a separate protection.
